blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will enjoy another round of fuel price rollbacks on Nov. 24, with cuts of up to P3 per liter. On Monday, Seaoil said in an advisory that gasoline and diesel prices will decrease by P3 and P2.60 per liter, respectively. READ: Bahrain says Iran struck industrial site as tankers hit in Hormuz This marks diesel’s fourth straight week of price drops, and the third for gasoline.
